references.text: Gideon threatened to tear down the tower of Penuel when he returned after victory, which is now fulfilled
Penuel is the place where Jacob wrestled with God and named the place Peniel, meaning 'face of God'
Penuel is mentioned as a city that Jeroboam rebuilt, showing it was reconstructed after Gideon's destruction
The men of Penuel refused to give bread to Gideon and his men, which led to the punishment described here
God's law commanded that cities refusing to submit to Israel should be severely punished
